E2.5.01: Two open paper hands, one red and one cobalt blue, gently exchange a few small ivory seed shapes. Both palms open and relaxed, no gripping, ties, coins or contract. Generous wide composition, tactile original metaphor of voluntary gratitude.
Dos manos de papel abiertas intercambian pequeñas semillas claras sin sujetarse.

A long thin soft red paper ribbon forms a loose open loop on an ivory surface beside an open blue hand, ribbon does not touch, bind or restrain the wrist or fingers. Calm gentle abstract gratitude metaphor. Landscape.
Una cinta roja forma un lazo abierto junto a una mano azul sin atarla.

A level simple blue balance sculpture with two ivory bowls, one containing a single red paper flower and the other a small red leafy branch; both sides level. No money, scales, measurements, numbers or value comparison of people. Landscape.
Balanza azul conceptual con una flor y una rama rojas en cuencos claros al mismo nivel.
E2.5.02: An open ivory notebook with entirely blank pages, above one page three soft red and blue luminous ribbons floating horizontally, no writing or actual ruled notes. Warm light, quiet reflective scene. No medicine, brain diagrams, before-and-after claims. Wide.
Cuaderno claro abierto y sin texto, con tres bandas luminosas rojas y azules encima.

A small blue pot holding a red and ivory paper plant leaning gently toward an unlabelled window with soft warm daylight. No growth measurements, arrows, charts, dates or implied clinical result. Landscape.
Planta de papel roja y clara se inclina hacia una ventana iluminada desde una maceta azul.

A large blue-handled magnifying glass examining three tiny red and blue rectangular paper blocks on an ivory tabletop, all short and separated, no axes, graph, labels, scales, measurements, numbers or data. Conceptual scrutiny of modest evidence, not an empirical chart. Landscape.
Lupa azul observa tres pequeños bloques de papel rojos y azules, sin ejes ni datos.
E2.5.03: One large original unbranded cobalt blue wooden pencil lying diagonally on an ivory ground, thin red paper threads extend gently from it toward three fictional miniature scenes: blue forest, red rocky excavation and ivory small factory. No logos, labels, routes or claims about an actual manufacturer. Wide landscape.
Lápiz azul sin marca enlazado por hilos rojos con bosque, excavación y fábrica ficticios.

A small ivory globe without geographic borders, text or precise map, surrounded by a loose circle of red and blue paper hands gently reaching toward one another. Symbolic voluntary cooperation, no chains, bindings or real organization insignia. Landscape.
Manos de papel rojas y azules rodean una esfera clara como símbolo de cooperación.

An ivory dining table with a simple blue plate, red loaf, ivory bowl of red fruit and a clear blue water jug; fine red and blue paper ribbons lead outward to small fictional plants, fields and workshop shapes in background. No maps, national flags, labels or actual provenance claim. Landscape.
Mesa con pan, fruta y agua conectada por cintas a campos y talleres simbólicos sin procedencias reales.
